name: Alfred Rosenberg
role: Nazi Party chief ideologue, head of its Foreign Affairs Office (1933-45) and Reich Minister for the Occupied Eastern Territories (1941-45); executed 1946
summary: Alfred Rosenberg, the Nazi Party's leading ideologist and author of The Myth of the Twentieth Century, set out a racial, anti-Jewish, anti-Christian and anti-parliamentary programme of Leader rule and a German national church, and as Reich Minister for the Occupied Eastern Territories oversaw plunder, ghettoisation and forced labour.

sources.title: Alfred Rosenberg, The Myth of the Twentieth Century (Der Mythus des 20. Jahrhunderts), English translation, Books I, III and V
sources.author: Alfred Rosenberg
sources.library: Alfred Rosenberg - The Myth of the Twentieth Century.txt
sources.usedFor: His programme for the state, sexes, race law, immigration, property, schools and a German national church.

sources.title: Judgment of the International Military Tribunal: Rosenberg, 30 September 1946, The Avalon Project (Yale)
sources.author: International Military Tribunal, Nuremberg
sources.usedFor: The Tribunal's findings of what he did: the 1923 Putsch, the Norway and Soviet Union planning, plunder of Jewish property, ghettos, forced labour.

sources.title: Nuremberg Trial Proceedings, 15-17 April 1946 (testimony of Rosenberg), The Avalon Project (Yale)
sources.author: Alfred Rosenberg
sources.usedFor: His sworn statements on the Jewish question, the churches and the occupied East.

notes: First audit. Words rest on The Myth of the Twentieth Century (local library copy; Books I, III and V read for the state, sexes, law, race, property, religion and schools); acts rest on the Nuremberg judgment on him. His own testimony at Nuremberg (15-17 April 1946, read) was largely denial or self-defence and was not counted as a held position. Searched without a settled answer: economics beyond property and settlement, criminal justice beyond punishment and race law, environment, technology, foreign policy beyond expansion, and most social-policy statements; these stay null.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Book III condemns cowardly pacifists who disarmed the army and says every culture arose under the protection of the sword.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Book III calls state and marriage the two greatest male acts of all time and defends marriage as a pillar of the racial order.

character-from-environment.rationale: Book I and III trace character and creativity to blood and race rather than environment.

class-collaboration.rationale: Book III: those who turn class into a declaration of war on fellow members of the people are deadly enemies of the people; socialism is national solidarity.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The preface: history no longer means class against class or one dogma against another but race against race, folk against folk.

clerical-rule.rationale: Throughout Books I and III the priesthood's claim to rule is attacked as a 'league of men' to be replaced by folkish state authority.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: The preface and Book III make struggle between races and peoples the task of the century and the basis of the folkish state.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Book V says denominational schools teaching geography and mathematics from Old Testament revelation must admit its falsehood, citing millions of years of earthly formation.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Book I and III rank races and their values; the Nordic soul is the highest value and race mixing destroys true values.

death-penalty.rationale: Book III: prison or the death penalty for national betrayal, and the death penalty for mocking race and folk, 'self-evident'.

defeat-communism.rationale: Book III: Bolshevism, a mixture of Babeuf, Blanc, Bakunin, Tolstoy, Lenin and Marx, has no room in Europe and must be eliminated.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Book III: betrayal of the people is a greater crime than high treason; he condemns pacifist and Marxist sabotage of the 1914-18 front.

democracy-best.rationale: Book III: democracy is the tool of capitalism and the moneyed classes and its demands must be broken with.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Book III calls the dictatorship of the proletariat world capitalism under other symbols.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Book III says a head of state chosen directly by 70 million is determined by money and no real Leader arrives; the Leader names his successor.

direct-votes.rationale: Book III: a folkish state will not make major decisions through anonymous male and female voting masses; such decisions are for responsible personalities.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Book III: marriages between Germans and Jews must be forbidden and intercourse between them punished by confiscation, expulsion, jail or death.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Book III: only men must be and remain judges, soldiers and rulers of the state, and women's franchise should go.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Book III: unhindered race mixing destroys all true values and leaves peoples an uncreative mass.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Book III: the fulfilment of duty and service for the honour of the people alone awards citizenship; honour and duty are the supreme values.

elective-rulers.rationale: Book III: the Leader determines his successor; election of the head of state is called a deceitful democratic demand.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Book III demands the complete rule of what is folkish over every form of internationalism and rejects supranational projects as 'faceless'.

equal-conscription.rationale: Book III: only men must be and remain soldiers.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Book III calls human equality an insane idea and holds that Jews must lose citizenship rights and be placed under their own law.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Book III: Germany is to be a race and national state; citizenship must be earned, with Jews losing it and non-Nordic immigration blocked. At Nuremberg (15 April 1946) he still defended the aim that the last Jew leave Europe, calling Jews a separate nation.

free-trade.rationale: Book III lists free trade among the liberal teachings that sinned against natural law and blames world trade and industrialisation for uprooting the nation.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Book III: only men must be judges, soldiers and rulers of the state.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Book III, 'The State and the Sexes': sexual polarity is a natural law and men and women differ in kind, so efforts to abolish the tension weaken creative powers.

harm-principle.rationale: Book III: punishment for dishonourable behaviour, even death for mocking race or folk, is justified by honour of the people, not harm to others.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Book III: the personal union of Leader, Reich Chancellor and Supreme Commander of the Wehrmacht is held up as ensuring the lessons of the World War are not repeated.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Book I and III hold that creative capacity, honour and culture are carried by race, with the Nordic race highest.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Book III: persons with hereditary diseases must be refused permanent residence or their capacity for reproduction restricted by medical intervention; he attacks the papal encyclical against it.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Book V says the schools still await a great teacher of German history and that a German view of history must become the matter of course for all Germans.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Book III's 'blood and soil' makes the folk's tie to its soil a spiritual one, with settlement on the land its precondition.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Book III places folk and race above the existing state and condemns abstract individualism; rights come only with service.

labour-priority-over-capital.rationale: Book III rejects the demand to elevate labour above property as an untenable abstraction and distinguishes kinds of property and of work.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Book V demands the abolition of the Old Testament as a book of religion; law is to rest on Nordic German racial law and honour.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: The preface calls the dead of the World War martyrs of a new dawn and dedicates the book to them.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: The preface makes the settlement between blood and blood and the struggle of spiritual values the content of history, against class and economic readings.

military-force-beyond-defence.rationale: The judgment finds he advised on and helped to carry out the war on the Soviet Union and the Norway operation, which went beyond defence.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Book III repeatedly describes a Jewish Marxist and democratic conspiracy against the German people, in finance and the press.

nation-first.rationale: Book III: all systems of ideas are only means to strengthen the nation's life struggle, and the folkish must rule over internationalism.

national-rebirth.rationale: The whole of the Myth, from its preface, sets out a collapse of values and calls for a new human type and a rebirth of the racial soul.

national-self-determination.rationale: Book III says the self-determination claims of 'inferior elements' interest him not at all, unless they strengthen what is Germanic.

natural-rulers.rationale: Book III favours a Council of the best, chosen from folkish 'type-forming personalities' under aristocratic laws of the blood; he does not tie it to birth as such.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Book III treats plutocratic democracy and Marxism as one system, 'world capitalism under other symbols', to be replaced by national socialism.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Book III: socialism is state safeguarding of the individual and the state is neutral to property, restricting it where dangers hide.

open-borders.rationale: Book III calls for racial protection and a race and national state and denounces racial barriers coming down as chaos; borders to be kept for Nordic Europe.

organic-representation.rationale: Book III has candidates proposed by guilds, associations and the German Order and chosen in communal elections, in place of party lists.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Book III condemns parliamentarianism as an honourless system and wants it replaced by appointment of responsible leaders.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Book III calls the claim that women were historically oppressed more falsehood than truth and says patriarchy was the basis of respect for women.

patriotic-education.rationale: Book V: state schools must educate soil-rooted citizens of the state, strengthening racial values.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Book III: nationalism and socialism both serve the economically oppressed; the Reich is 'Nationalist and Socialist'.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Book III says parliamentary systems reward unscrupulous parliamentarians who avoid responsibility, and describes democratic ministers who took bribes.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: The judgment records that he took part in the Munich Putsch of 9 November 1923 and kept the banned party together while Hitler was in jail.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Book III, 'A New System of State', rejects Pan-Europe as a faceless 'Francojudea' and says there will be no faceless central Europe, only a German-led Nordic order.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Book III treats the type-forming personalities and values of the German people as the thing to be protected and cultivated through the schools and a German church.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Book III says property is congealed labour and only gain from stock-exchange dealing is illegitimate; it rejects a blanket struggle against capital as such.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Book III: the state recognises property where it ensures security for the whole and restricts it where it conceals dangers; property gained by speculation is to be confiscated.

proportional-representation.rationale: Book III criticises elections by party lists, where the list rather than the person decides, and wants appointment of responsible leaders by the Leader.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: Book III: citizenship open to Nordic Scandinavians, insuperable difficulties for 'mulattoid' migrants from the south or east.

race-social-construct.rationale: Book I: race is the outer side of a soul and the basis of history and values, not a convention.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The preface makes the settlement between races and peoples the task of the century; each race should assert its own values.

racial-pride.rationale: The Myth's central value is the honour of the racial soul, 'the Myth of the Blood'.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The judgment records that his directives provided for the segregation of Jews in the occupied East, ultimately in ghettos.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Book III, Nordic German law, wants insuperable difficulties placed in the way of migration of 'mulattoid elements' from south or east while Nordic Scandinavians may be admitted; a restriction by race rather than a general limit.

rehabilitation.rationale: Book III, Nordic German law: punishment is not in the first instance a means of education, as 'humanitarians' wish, nor revenge, but the singling out of types alien to the people.

religion-from-peoples-character.rationale: Book V proposes a German national church formed from the Nordic race soul and Nordic sagas, in place of 'Syrian Roman' Christianity.

return-to-pre-conversion-religion.rationale: Book V: Nordic sagas and legends are to replace the Old Testament in a German church, against Syrian Roman Christianity.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: The judgment records his participation in the 1923 Putsch and his work for the party's seizure of power.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Book III calls the farmer stock the strongest support of every people and demands the demolition of the great cities and resettlement on the land.

school-vouchers.rationale: Book V: the national state must claim sole control of schools without compromise, and no statesman may hand the education of youth to a church.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Book V calls the Old Testament's scientific claims disproved, and the creation story, Noah's Ark and the 6,000 years refuted by natural science.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Book III: economic individualism as a principle of state equates a successful swindler with a man of honour; duty and honour are the supreme values.

separate-church-state.rationale: Book V: the state grants support to churches according to how far their teaching serves the strengthening of souls, and a German church must serve the security of the folk.

separated-powers.rationale: Book III praises the personal union of Leader, Reich Chancellor and Supreme Commander of the Wehrmacht as a successful safeguard and attacks the diffused responsibility of parliaments.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Book III attacks the doctrine of human equality and a universal humanity; values belong to racial souls.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Book III praises the army of honour and duty and condemns pacifist democrats who betrayed it.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Book III calls the dictatorship of the proletariat a concentration of power that leaves world capitalism standing under other symbols.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Book III calls the bourgeois parliamentary state a class state but says the state properly serves neither bourgeoisie nor Marxist class struggle, so it is not 'essentially' a ruling-class tool.

state-harmful.rationale: Book III, 'Folk and State': without the state Marxism and international capitalism cannot be overcome; he wants a stronger folkish state, not its abolition.

strong-leader.rationale: Book III replaces election with appointment of responsible leaders by the Leader and condemns democracy as the rule of money; the Leader unites state, chancellery and command of the Wehrmacht.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Book V: no action of a German church is permitted that does not first serve the security of the folkhood, and the state backs creeds in proportion to their service to it.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The judgment finds he helped plan the attack on Norway and the war on the Soviet Union and ran the occupation of the Eastern territories, with Germanisation and exploitation of them.

traditional-family.rationale: Book III, 'The State and the Sexes', rejects the view that the family is the cell of the state as a coercive dogma and says the family was nowhere the most important pillar of a state; it is the league of men that founds states.

universal-morality.rationale: Book I and III hold that values are conditioned by racial soul and that honour is the supreme value of the Nordic soul, against universal Christian love or humanitarianism.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Book III condemns the growth of landless, propertyless Germans and proposes deproletarianisation by decentralisation and settlement on the land.

women-suffrage.rationale: Book III: the universal right to vote is to be taken away from women, and from men too.

workers-nation.rationale: Book III condemns Marxist internationalism and class war and demands the folkish above international solidarity.
